Brought to you by Pottermore.


The Triwizard Tournament is to be held at Hogwarts and only witches and wizards aged over seventeen can enter. But when the Goblet of Fire makes its selection, Harry is amazed to be picked out by the magical cup. He must now take part in three tasks, but with the help of his best friends, Ron and Hermione, can he survive? In Order of the Phoenix, Harry knows Voldemort will stop at nothing to find him. But Harry is not alone: a secret order gathers at Grimmauld Place to battle the Dark forces. Harry will need powerful magic and true friends as he prepares to face his destiny...

descriptions.mainHtml:
Brought to you by Pottermore.


The Triwizard Tournament is to be held at Hogwarts and only witches and wizards aged over seventeen can enter. But when the Goblet of Fire makes its selection, Harry is amazed to be picked out by the magical cup. He must now take part in three tasks, but with the help of his best friends, Ron and Hermione, can he survive? In Order of the Phoenix, Harry knows Voldemort will stop at nothing to find him. But Harry is not alone: a secret order gathers at Grimmauld Place to battle the Dark forces. In Half-Blood Prince, secrets and suspicion are spreading through the wizarding world, and Hogwarts itself is not safe. Harry will need powerful magic and true friends as he prepares to face his destiny...


In the final book of the series, Harry leaves Privet Drive forever. The protective charm, which kept Harry safe until now is broken, but he cannot keep hiding. The final battle will begin, and Harry must stand and face his greatest enemy.


Continue the magic:


Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows


Having become classics of our time, the Harry Potter stories never fail to bring comfort and escapism. With their message of hope, belonging and the enduring power of truth and love, the story of the Boy Who Lived continues to delight generations of new listeners. All Harry Potter Yoto Cards feature a shimmering, foil effect on the card and packaging for the ultimate magical touch.


A Note From Yoto: Harry Potter is a magical adventure that continues to captivate new generations of readers and listeners. Books 4-7 have some sensitive themes and fast-paced action. They are recommended for listeners aged 9 and up.
